name: @teasel/parser
description: A JavaScript and TypeScript parser in Rust. It answers in ESTree.

scripts.build:js: tsc --ignoreConfig node.ts wasm.ts plan.ts --declaration --erasableSyntaxOnly --strict --target es2022 --module esnext --moduleResolution bundler --lib es2022,dom --types node --skipLibCheck
scripts.build:wasm: cargo build --release -p teasel-wasm --target wasm32-unknown-unknown && wasm-opt -Oz --all-features ../target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/teasel_wasm.wasm -o teasel.wasm
scripts.test: npm run build:js && node scripts/test.ts && node scripts/test.ts interpret
